en: The image shows an old, colorized view of a large, quadrangular neoclassical market hall with a colonnaded portico in an urban setting. Horse-drawn carriages and people in period clothing can be seen around the building. The background consists of a densely built historical European cityscape. There are three lines of text at the top left of the image, reading 'DORPAT. TARTU.', 'Kaufhof.', and 'Kaubahoon.'
